description.value: Point Atkinson Lighthouse, built in 1912 and designated a National Historic Site of Canada, stands at the tip of the Lighthouse Park headland in West Vancouver. The lighthouse remains an active navigational aid and is one of the most photographed landmarks on the BC coast. Cyclists riding the West Vancouver waterfront routes often make it a destination, reaching it via the trail network through old-growth forest in Lighthouse Park.
